text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P0 — Dedicated pool 'enclave-enterprise' (region us-east-1) GPU utilization 99% — tenant 'Enkor' drives sustained queue growth. Link: https://redwood/alerts/1748765432

incident-bot: Details: queued=412, running=32, avg_latency=4.8s, burst_buffer=0, autoscale=disabled (contracted).

sarah-oncall: I'm on call — investigating. pinging infra and account team.

mike-rt: seeing massive enqueue on tenant Enkor endpoint /v1/generate-chat, many long-seq requests. QPS spike ~x8. Logs show many 2k+ token inputs.

jordan-sre: confirmed pool is single-tenant dedicated; autoscale is disabled per Ent contract (no auto-burst).

alex-platform: We have an emergency burst pool 'burst-1' with 8 GPUs reserved. Policy: manual approval required for >4 GPUs. Also need AE approval for cross-tenant spill.

liz-acc: I'm Enkor's AE — I can approve a temporary burst. Customer tolerates short burst but prefers no model changes without notice.

sarah-oncall: TL;DR: need quick mitigation to restore latency while we coordinate with customer. Proposal: manual burst + enable temporary fallback to quantized smaller model for the heaviest sequence lengths. Approve? :point_up: 

mike-rt: currently 503s creeping up as queue overflows. sample log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T02:10:03Z ERROR serve: request rejected tenant=enkor reason=queue_full
2026-03-17T02:10:03Z WARN runtime: kvcache pressure, attempting eviction
```

sarah-oncall: alex, can you allocate 6 GPUs from burst-1 to enclave-enterprise? that's within contract w/AE ok. I'll get liz to confirm in-thread.

alex-platform: running command now:
```
clusterctl allocate --pool enclave-enterprise --from burst-1 --gpus 6 --note "emergency: Enkor prod exhaustion"
```

opsbot: Allocation requested by alex-platform. Waiting for quota & node health checks.

opsbot: Allocation approved. Allocated 6 GPUs (nodes: burst-1-[03..05]). Routing updated.

mike-rt: queue dropping quickly — queued=68 now, running=110, avg_latency=320ms. Throughput improving.

sarah-oncall: liz, can you confirm Enkor authorizes this burst? need explicit approval logged.

liz-acc: Authorize. Enkor agreed to emergency 6-GPU burst. They want us to monitor and notify if we enable any model fallbacks.

jordan-sre: note: a subset of failures were model OOMs on long sequences with the current 13B variant. If traffic stays heavy, recommend enabling fallback to quantized-3B or quantized-1.3B for >1024 token requests.

mike-rt: starting routing rule to divert requests with input_length > 1024 to quantized-3B for Enkor. Patch: `route-override tenant=enkor max_len>1024 -> model=redwood/qltz-3b`

alex-platform: applied route-override. Verified traffic match samples are now hitting qltz-3b. No config reload required.

incident-bot: Change recorded: route-override applied by mike-rt at 1748765560.

mike-rt: latency stabilized: avg_latency=210ms, errors down to 0.7%. Queue ~40 and draining.

sarah-oncall: Good. Monitoring window 20m. If stable, we'll deallocate burst and create a follow-up: contract review for autoscale or larger emergency buffers.

alex-platform: note for postmortem — policy mismatch: contract blocking autoscale + lack of clear rapid-approval path caused manual steps.

jordan-sre: also capture: customer workload pattern (spiky long-seq) — ops should suggest rate-limit or per-route quotas if Enkor wants to avoid repeated bursts.

liz-acc: I'll notify Enkor (they're on standby). I'll tell them we used a temporary burst and enabled fallback for long inputs; we will not change default model for normal requests.

sarah-oncall: handoff: I'm staying on for 10 more mins, then handing to jordan-sre for monitoring and post-incident follow-up.

jordan-sre: acknowledged, taking monitoring at 1748765699. I'll open follow-up tickets: PM-Policy, Postmortem, Customer-Action.

sarah-oncall: final state at handoff — GPUs added: +6, queue=22, avg_latency=180ms, error_rate=0.5%.

incident-bot: Incident P0 status: mitigation in place, customer notified, follow-ups scheduled.

sarah-oncall: thanks team. We'll keep the burst for up to 2 hours pending product/AE discussion.

liz-acc: customer asks for a short note with timeline — I'll prepare and post in #customer-facing-updates.

jordan-sre: postmortem draft assigned to @jordan-sre, severity P1, include timeline and recommended contract/autoscale changes.

opsbot: Created tickets: TID-8742 (postmortem), TID-8743 (policy review), TID-8744 (quota/rate-limit suggestion).

sarah-oncall: handing off now. jordan-sre is primary. closing live thread. :white_check_mark:
